ns2:section.sectionText: This course will examine three dominant rhetorics of recognition: citizenship, rights, and notions of shared humanity. Rather than providing a comprehensive study of each of these three key terms, the course will approach them as discourses through which claims are made for social and political acknowledgment, respect, and/or membership. In other words, our goal will be to study origins, effects, and expressions of citizenship, rights, and humanity as languages used to demand recognition in US and (to a lesser degree) international political culture.
